title: SwiftBindings.Apple type metadata manifest
description: Authoritative metadata for Apple Swift-only types bound into the SwiftBindings.Apple supplement package. Consumed by the generator's TypeDatabase and by the supplement source-generation pipeline. See src/docs/Design/apple-swift-types-architecture.md §Q7 for the design contract. Format is intentionally self-contained so a later extraction into a standalone SwiftBindings.Apple.Metadata data package is a relocation, not a reformat.

manifest_version.description: Schema version. Increment on breaking shape changes.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp or null for hand-seeded manifests.

major.description: Apple SDK train major (Xcode SDK major, e.g. 18 for iOS 18 / macOS 15 / Xcode 16). Also serves as the SwiftBindings.Apple NuGet package major.

platforms.description: Minimum platform version this manifest was generated against. Per-type availability may raise the floor further.

type.description: A Swift-only type owned by SwiftBindings.Apple. Carries the 3-way TypeRecord split: swift_identity / managed_projection / abi_carrier (architecture doc §Implementation specifics item 5).

swift_identity.description: Dotted Swift identity, e.g. 'Foundation.Locale.Language'. Matches ABI JSON usr/name after normalization.

frozen.description: ABI JSON 'frozen' flag. Necessary but NOT sufficient for sequential layout (architecture doc §Q8).

storage_strategy.description: Default is vwt_opaque per architecture doc §Decision summary item 3. 'sequential' requires whitelist + validation; see sequential_layout_whitelisted.

sequential_layout_whitelisted.description: Per-type explicit opt-in to [StructLayout(Sequential)] emission. Requires frozen=true, layout-known fields, size/alignment validated, copy/destroy trivial or handled, and a passing runtime round-trip test. When true, sequential_layout_evidence MUST be present with every condition affirmative; otherwise the emitter refuses the sequential path, falls back to vwt_opaque, and fails the validation gate.

conformance_descriptors.description: Cross-module protocol conformances anchored on this type. Conformance ownership may differ from type ownership (architecture doc §Q10 item 3).

status.description: Provenance tag. 'seed-placeholder' marks manually-seeded skeleton entries; 'generated' marks entries produced by Session 2's ABI-JSON pipeline.

typealias.description: Typealias as alias/projection metadata — NOT duplicate type identity (architecture doc §Q10 item 4). Example: 'ApplicationToken = Token<Application>'.

sequential_layout_evidence.description: Evidence that a sequential-layout opt-in is safe. Every field must be affirmative to activate the opt-in; a whitelist claim without matching evidence is refused at emission time and falls back to vwt_opaque with a hard diagnostic that fails the validation gate.

stored_fields_known.description: True when every stored field's layout is known to the whitelist author and matches the SDK's ABI for the Swift compiler the supplement ships against.

copy_destroy_handling.description: Handling strategy for copy/destroy semantics. 'trivial' = bitwise-copyable, no ARC. 'explicit_vwt' = sequential layout but copies/destroys still routed through the VWT.

roundtrip_validated.description: True when a live-SDK round-trip test (construct in Swift, marshal to C#, marshal back, field-wise equality) has passed against the target SDK.

namespace.description: CLR namespace root for the type (e.g. 'Swift.Foundation').

declaration_path.description: Nested declaration path from the namespace to the type. E.g. ['Locale', 'Language'] means 'Swift.Foundation.Locale.Language'.

metadata_accessor.description: Pointer-to-metadata accessor symbol. The Swift ABI mandates these for resilient types; the generator uses them to obtain the VWT at runtime.

symbol.description: Mangled symbol name for the metadata accessor. Must be non-empty — an empty symbol would emit a [DllImport(..., EntryPoint = "")] at codegen time, which silently resolves to an arbitrary export and crashes at runtime.

library.description: Short dylib/framework name (Foundation, ManagedSettings, ...) used for [DllImport]. Must be non-empty.

weak_link.description: Must be weak-linked (platform-guard P/Invoke). Required when availability exceeds the supplement's SupportedOSPlatformVersion floor.

source.description: 'metadata': VWT is obtained at runtime via the metadata accessor (resilient types). 'static_symbol': VWT is a known static symbol (rare, frozen types only).

trivial.description: True when copy/destroy are memcpy + noop. Informational; runtime round-trip is still required before sequential-layout whitelist.

owning_module.description: Module that declares the conformance (may differ from the type's module).

availability.description: Per-platform minimum version the symbol is available on, or null for not-available-on-that-platform.
